# A6 — sign action 'build-tools not found'

**Section**: A. Build pipeline
**Keywords**: action, android_home, android_sdk_root, build, build-tools, build_tools_version, compute, custom, found, pipeline, read, runner, sign, source, third-party, upstream

## Problem

sign action 'build-tools not found'

## Root cause

action read ANDROID_HOME (runner SDK), we used ANDROID_SDK_ROOT (custom SDK)

## Solution

compute BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION from ANDROID_HOME like upstream; read third-party action source before use
